title: Study of Dasatinib (BMS-354825) in Patients With Accelerated Phase Chronic Myeloid Leukemia

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this clinical research study is to learn if BMS-354825 will have activity, defined by hematologic response, in subjects who have accelerated phase chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) who are resistant to or intolerant to imatinib mesylate. The safety of this treatment will also be studied.

Posted outcomes: Major and Overall Hematologic Response (MaHR and OHR). timeframe=Baseline (within 72 hours of therapy start); Cycle 1/Day 1; Weekly during treatm. Imatinib-intolerant=9; Imatinib-resistant=103; Total=112
